               SUM(product_price) AS total_revenue
        FROM Products

ORDER BY ct.total_revenue DESC;

WITH staff_counts AS (
  SELECT s.staff_id,
         s.first_name,
         s.last_name,
         COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count
  FROM Staff s
  LEFT JOIN Complaints c
    ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
   AND c.date_complaint_raised >= date('now', '-1 year')
  GROUP BY s.staff_id
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(complaint_count) AS avg_cnt FROM staff_counts
)
SELECT sc.first_name, sc.last_name
FROM staff_counts sc
CROSS JOIN avg_count a
WHERE sc.complaint_count > a.avg_cnt
ORDER BY sc.complaint_count DESC;

SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Staff s
JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
WHERE c.date_complaint_raised >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
HAVING COUNT(c.complaint_id) > (
    SELECT AVG(complaint_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
        FROM Complaints
        WHERE date_complaint_raised >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
        GROUP BY staff_id
    )
)
ORDER BY COUNT(c.complaint_id) DESC;

WITH recent_complaints AS (
  SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt
  FROM Complaints
  WHERE date_complaint_raised >= date((SELECT MAX(date_complaint_raised) FROM Complaints), '-1 year')
  GROUP BY staff_id
),
all_staff AS (
  SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name,
         COALESCE(rc.complaint_cnt, 0) AS complaint_cnt
  FROM Staff s
  LEFT JOIN recent_complaints rc ON s.staff_id = rc.staff_id
),
avg_complaints AS (
  SELECT AVG(complaint_cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM all_staff
)
SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS staff_name
FROM all_staff a, avg_complaints av
WHERE a.complaint_cnt > av.avg_cnt
ORDER BY a.complaint_cnt DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH complaints_with_category AS (
        SELECT 
            p.product_category_code,
            strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_closed) AS yr,
            ((CAST(strftime('%m', c.date_complaint_closed) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS qtr,
            (julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS days_to_close,
            p.product_price
        FROM Complaints c
        JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
        WHERE c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
    ),
    quarterly_agg AS (
        SELECT 
            product_category_code,
            yr,
            qtr,
            AVG(days_to_close) AS avg_close_days,
            SUM(product_price) AS total_revenue
        FROM complaints_with_category
        GROUP BY product_category_code, yr, qtr
    ),
    with_lags AS (
        SELECT 
            product_category_code,
            yr,
            qtr,
            avg_close_days,
            total_revenue,
            LAG(avg_close_days) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY CAST(yr AS INTEGER), qtr) AS prev_avg_close_days,
            LAG(total_revenue)   OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY CAST(yr AS INTEGER), qtr) AS prev_total_revenue
        FROM quarterly_agg
    )
SELECT 
    product_category_code,
    yr,
    qtr,
    avg_close_days,
    total_revenue,
    CASE WHEN prev_avg_close_days IS NOT NULL AND prev_avg_close_days <> 0 THEN
        (prev_avg_close_days - avg_close_days) * 100.0 / prev_avg_close_days
    END AS pct_change_avg_close_days,
    CASE WHEN prev_total_revenue IS NOT NULL AND prev_total_revenue <> 0 THEN
        (total_revenue - prev_total_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_total_revenue
    END AS pct_change_total_revenue
FROM with_lags
WHERE prev_avg_close_days IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_change_avg_close_days DESC;

WITH complaint_quarterly AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_code,
        strftime('%Y-Q%Q', c.date_complaint_closed) AS quarter,
        julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised) AS days_to_close,
        p.product_price
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
),
quarterly_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_code,
        quarter,
        AVG(days_to_close) AS avg_days_to_close,
        SUM(product_price) AS total_revenue_proxy
    FROM complaint_quarterly
    GROUP BY product_category_code, quarter
),
with_qoq AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_code,
        quarter,
        avg_days_to_close,
        total_revenue_proxy,
        LAG(avg_days_to_close) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY quarter) AS prev_avg_days,
        LAG(total_revenue_proxy) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY quarter) AS prev_revenue
    FROM quarterly_metrics
)
SELECT 
    avg_days_to_close,
    total_revenue_proxy,
    ROUND(((avg_days_to_close - prev_avg_days) / prev_avg_days) * 100, 2) AS days_qoq_change_pct,
    ROUND(((total_revenue_proxy - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100, 2) AS revenue_qoq_change_pct
FROM with_qoq
WHERE prev_avg_days IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY days_qoq_change_pct ASC

WITH complaint_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_category_code,
        strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised) AS year_str,
        ((CAST(strftime('%m', c.date_complaint_raised) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1 AS quarter,
        (julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS days_to_close,
        p.product_price AS price
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL AND c.date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        product_category_code,
        CAST(year_str AS INTEGER) AS year,
        quarter,
        AVG(days_to_close) AS avg_days_close,
        SUM(price) AS total_revenue
    FROM complaint_data
    GROUP BY product_category_code, year, quarter
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        product_category_code,
        year,
        quarter,
        avg_days_close,
        total_revenue,
        (avg_days_close - LAG(avg_days_close) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY year, quarter)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(avg_days_close) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY year, quarter), 0) AS pct_change_avg_days,
        (total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY year, quarter)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_code ORDER BY year, quarter), 0) AS pct_change_revenue
    FROM agg
)
SELECT
    product_category_code,
    year,
    quarter,
    avg_days_close,
    total_revenue,
    pct_change_avg_days,
    pct_change_revenue
FROM final
ORDER BY pct_change_avg_days ASC;

-- Note: The provided schema does not contain department, supervisor/hierarchy, or organization-related fields.
-- This query addresses what IS available from the schema:
-- 1. Staff member names
-- 2. Count of pending (Open) complaints assigned to each staff member
-- 3. Average complaint closure duration ranking among staff

WITH staff_pending_complaints AS (
    SELECT 
        s.staff_id,
        s.first_name,
        s.last_name,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.complaint_status_code = 'Open' THEN 1 END) AS pending_complaint_count
    FROM Staff s
    LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
    GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
),
staff_closure_duration AS (
    SELECT 
        s.staff_id,
        AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS avg_closure_days
    FROM Staff s
    INNER JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
    WHERE c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL AND c.date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.staff_id
),
staff_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        spd.staff_id,
        spd.pending_complaint_count,
        scd.avg_closure_days,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.avg_closure_days ASC) * 100 AS performance_percentile
    FROM staff_pending_complaints spd
    LEFT JOIN staff_closure_duration scd ON spd.staff_id = scd.staff_id
)
SELECT 
    sr.first_name || ' ' || sr.last_name AS staff_name,
    sr.pending_complaint_count,
    sr.performance_percentile
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.first_name,
        s.last_name,
        COALESCE(spc.pending_complaint_count, 0) AS pending_complaint_count,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.avg_closure_days ASC) * 100,
                0
            ), 2
        ) AS performance_percentile
    FROM Staff s
    LEFT JOIN staff_pending_complaints spc ON s.staff_id = spc.staff_id
    LEFT JOIN staff_closure_duration scd ON s.staff_id = scd.staff_id
) sr;

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', c.date_complaint_raised) AS month,
    p.product_category_code AS category,
    SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Products AS p
      ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.date_complaint_raised >= date('now', '-6 months')
GROUP BY month, category
ORDER BY month DESC, category;

WITH recent AS (
    SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE date_complaint_raised >= (SELECT date(MAX(date_complaint_raised), '-1 year') FROM Complaints)
    GROUP BY staff_id
),
maxc AS (
    SELECT MAX(complaint_count) AS max_cnt FROM recent
)
SELECT
    s.first_name,
    s.last_name,
    s.phone_number,
    CASE WHEN r.complaint_count = m.max_cnt THEN 'Yes' ELSE NULL END AS top_complaint_handler
FROM Staff s
LEFT JOIN recent r ON s.staff_id = r.staff_id
CROSS JOIN maxc m
ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;

votes.sql:
-- Note: There is no 'Suppliers' table in this schema. 
-- Assuming the question intended to ask about Customers (who have addresses and contact info)
-- Here is a query that returns customer contact info, their associated products via complaints, and complaint counts

SELECT 
    c.last_name || ', ' || c.first_name AS supplier_name,
    c.address_line_1,
    c.address_line_2,
    c.town_city,
    c.state,
    c.phone_number,
    c.email_address,
    p.product_name,
    COUNT(com.complaint_id) AS total_recent_complaints
FROM Customers c
INNER JOIN Complaints com ON c.customer_id = com.customer_id
INNER JOIN Products p ON com.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE com.date_complaint_raised >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, p.product_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id, p.product_id;

votes.sql:
WITH recent_complaints AS (
    SELECT c.staff_id, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
    FROM Complaints c
    WHERE c.date_complaint_raised >= date((SELECT MAX(date_complaint_raised) FROM Complaints), '-1 year')
    GROUP BY c.staff_id
)
SELECT
    s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS supplier_name,
    s.phone_number,
    s.email_address,
    COALESCE(rc.complaint_count, 0) AS complaint_count
FROM Staff s
LEFT JOIN recent_complaints rc ON s.staff_id = rc.staff_id
ORDER BY s.staff_id;

votes.sql:
WITH recent_pf AS (
        SELECT c.staff_id, c.product_id
        FROM Complaints c
        WHERE c.complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
          AND c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed'
          AND c.date_complaint_closed >= date('now','-10 years')
    ),
    staff_agg AS (
        SELECT s.staff_id,
               COUNT(*) AS complaints_solved,
               SUM(p.product_price) AS total_price
        FROM recent_pf r
        JOIN Staff s ON s.staff_id = r.staff_id
        JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id
        GROUP BY s.staff_id
    )
SELECT staff_id,
       complaints_solved,
       total_price,
       SUM(complaints_solved) OVER (ORDER BY complaints_solved DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_complaints,
       SUM(total_price) OVER (ORDER BY complaints_solved DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_profit
FROM staff_agg
ORDER BY complaints_solved DESC;

SELECT 
    c.staff_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.complaint_id) AS total_complaints_solved,
    AVG(CASE WHEN d.value IS NOT NULL THEN d.value ELSE p.product_price END) AS avg_value
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT staff_id
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
        AND complaint_status_code = 'Closed'
        AND date_complaint_closed >= datetime('now', '-10 years')
) qualifying_staff ON c.staff_id = qualifying_staff.staff_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 1 AS dummy
) d ON 1=1
WHERE qualifying_staff.staff_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.staff_id
ORDER BY total_complaints_solved DESC

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(date_complaint_closed) AS max_closed FROM Complaints),
filtered AS (
  SELECT c.staff_id, p.product_price
  FROM Complaints c
  JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE c.complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
    AND c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed'
    AND c.date_complaint_closed >= date((SELECT max_closed FROM max_date), '-10 years')
)
SELECT
  staff_id,
  COUNT(*) AS total_complaints_solved,
  SUM(product_price) AS total_profit_margin
FROM filtered
GROUP BY staff_id
ORDER BY total_complaints_solved DESC;

WITH staff_total AS (
        SELECT c.staff_id, SUM(p.product_price) AS total_value
        FROM Complaints c
        JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
        GROUP BY c.staff_id
    ),
    max_total AS (
        SELECT MAX(total_value) AS max_val FROM staff_total
    ),
    top_staff AS (
        SELECT staff_id FROM staff_total WHERE total_value = (SELECT max_val FROM max_total)
    )
SELECT s.staff_id,
       s.first_name,
       s.last_name,
       strftime('%Y-%m', c.date_complaint_raised) AS month,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS monthly_performance_rating
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE s.staff_id IN (SELECT staff_id FROM top_staff)
GROUP BY s.staff_id, month
ORDER BY s.staff_id, month;

votes.sql:
WITH staff_locations AS (
    SELECT s.staff_id,
           c.address_line_1 AS building,
           c.address_line_2 AS floor
    FROM Staff s
    JOIN Complaints comp ON s.staff_id = comp.staff_id
    JOIN Customers c ON comp.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
staff_counts AS (
    SELECT staff_id
    FROM staff_locations
    GROUP BY staff_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT building || '|' || floor) > 2
)
SELECT sl.staff_id,
       sl.building,
       sl.floor
FROM staff_locations sl
JOIN staff_counts sc ON sl.staff_id = sc.staff_id
ORDER BY sl.staff_id, sl.building, sl.floor;

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           cu.state,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spending
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, cu.state
)
SELECT customer_id,
       state,
       total_spending,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY total_spending DESC) AS spending_rank
FROM customer_spending
ORDER BY state, spending_rank;

-- Note: The provided schema does not contain sales/transaction tables.
-- This query structure assumes an Orders/Sales table exists with the expected fields.
-- Without actual sales transaction data, this cannot return valid revenue figures.

WITH monthly_category_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_code,
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS sales_month,
        SUM(p.product_price * o.quantity) AS monthly_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.return_flag = 1 THEN p.product_price * o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS returns_revenue,
        SUM(p.product_price * o.quantity) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.return_flag = 1 THEN p.product_price * o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue
    FROM Products p
    INNER JOIN Orders o ON p.product_id = o.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_code, strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)
),
cumulative_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        mcr.product_category_code,
        mcr.sales_month,
        mcr.monthly_revenue,
        mcr.returns_revenue,
        mcr.net_revenue,
        SUM(mcr.net_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY mcr.product_category_code ORDER BY mcr.sales_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue,
        LAG(mcr.net_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY mcr.product_category_code ORDER BY mcr.sales_month) AS prev_month_revenue
    FROM monthly_category_revenue mcr
),
growth_rate_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_code,
        sales_month,
        monthly_revenue,
        returns_revenue,
        net_revenue,
        cumulative_revenue,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_month_revenue IS NULL OR prev_month_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((net_revenue - prev_month_revenue) / prev_month_revenue * 100, 2)
        END AS mom_growth_rate_percent
    FROM cumulative_revenue
)
SELECT 
    product_category_code,
    sales_month,
    monthly_revenue,
    returns_revenue,
    net_revenue,
    cumulative_revenue,
    mom_growth_rate_percent
FROM growth_rate_calc
ORDER BY product_category_code, sales_month
